_kommentar: Hier kannst du die Departments bearbeiten – Beschreibungen, Aufgaben und den 'Learn & grow' Text.

departments.name: Human Resources
departments.beschreibung: We find the raw diamonds in Maastricht's startup ecosystem, work hard with you to take the next step in your entrepreneurial journey, and most importantly, we build a community that feels like a family!

departments.name: Marketing
departments.beschreibung: We find creative and fun ways to engage with our ecosystem, communicate our values and vision, and connect students, partners, and universities through fresh storytelling and branding.

departments.name: Operations
departments.beschreibung: The backbone of our organization. We make sure our processes run smoothly, finances are sound, and START is set up for long-term operational success.

departments.name: Partnerships
departments.beschreibung: We establish and nurture flourishing partnerships that unite entrepreneurial minds, creating tangible impact for members, partners, and Maastricht's startup ecosystem.

learn_and_grow.intro: As an active member in one of our departments, you take real ownership of projects from day one, expanding your hard and soft skills in a supportive team.

aufgaben.beschreibung: Turn ambitious ideas into reality. Whether organizing major competitions or rolling out new initiatives, you develop proactive project management and execution skills.
Learn directly from experienced founders and industry experts through hands-on masterclasses in fundraising, marketing, operations, and leadership.
Build genuine connections with founders, innovators, and our Europe-wide START network across 22+ cities that accelerate your personal and professional journey.
